name: Architecture
title: Booking API v1
summary: Express API → services → data access → Postgres. Services, customers, staff, staff_hours, bookings. No double bookings enforced in the DB and in a locking transaction.
diagram:
flowchart LR C[Client / Bruno] --> R[Routes + Zod] R --> S[Services
business rules] S --> D[Data access
Drizzle] D --> P[(Postgres
pgvector image)] S -. transaction + FOR UPDATE .-> P
folders:
booking/
├─ src/
│  ├─ routes/        # HTTP only: parse, validate, call service
│  ├─ services/      # business rules (no double booking, no past bookings)
│  ├─ data/          # Drizzle queries, the only place SQL lives
│  ├─ schemas/       # Zod
│  └─ index.ts
├─ drizzle/          # versioned migrations
├─ scripts/          # seed.ts, import-customers.ts
├─ tests/
├─ bruno/
├─ docker-compose.yml
└─ AGENTS.md
schema:
customers(id, name, email UNIQUE, phone, created_at)
services(id, name, duration_min CHECK > 0, price_cents CHECK >= 0)
staff(id, name)
staff_hours(id, staff_id → staff, weekday 0-6, opens_at, closes_at)
bookings(id, customer_id → customers RESTRICT, service_id → services RESTRICT,
         staff_id → staff RESTRICT, starts_at timestamptz, ends_at timestamptz,
         status CHECK in ('booked','cancelled'))
UNIQUE (staff_id, starts_at) WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
INDEX bookings(starts_at); GIN (name gin_trgm_ops) on customers
api:
GET    /health
GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /services
GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /customers
POST   /bookings                 → 201 | 400 | 409
GET    /bookings?date=&q=&page=  → 200 paginated
POST   /bookings/:id/cancel      → 200 (status = cancelled)
GET    /availability?date=&serviceId=
flow:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as Client
  participant R as Route
  participant S as Service
  participant DB as Postgres
  U->>R: POST /bookings
  R->>R: Zod validate
  R->>S: createBooking(input)
  S->>DB: BEGIN
  S->>DB: SELECT staff FOR UPDATE
  S->>DB: overlap query
  alt overlaps
    S-->>R: ConflictError
    R-->>U: 409
  else free
    S->>DB: INSERT booking
    S->>DB: COMMIT
    R-->>U: 201
  end

name: Authentication
title: Booking API v2
summary: Users and roles (owner, staff, customer). Cookie JWT sessions, Google login, permission middleware on every route, Helmet/CORS/rate limits/Origin check, CI with Postgres service.
diagram:
flowchart LR B[Browser] -->|cookie JWT| M[Helmet · CORS · RateLimit · Origin check] M --> A[authenticate] A --> P[permission middleware
role + ownership] P --> R[Routes → Services → DB] G[Google OIDC] -.->|code + state| A
folders:
src/
├─ middleware/
│  ├─ authenticate.ts
│  ├─ permit.ts        # permit('owner') | ownsBooking
│  ├─ origin-check.ts
│  └─ rate-limit.ts
├─ auth/
│  ├─ password.ts      # argon2
│  ├─ tokens.ts        # JWT sign/verify (1h)
│  └─ google.ts        # Arctic
└─ routes/auth.ts
schema:
users(id, email, password_hash NULL, role CHECK in ('owner','staff','customer'), google_sub NULL UNIQUE)
UNIQUE INDEX ON users (lower(email))
customers.user_id → users ; staff.user_id → users
api:
POST /signup  POST /login  POST /logout  GET /me
GET  /auth/google  GET /auth/google/callback
POST /auth/google/link   (confirm password)
All booking routes: 401 if no session, 403 if wrong role / not owner of the booking
flow:
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant API
  participant G as Google
  B->>API: GET /auth/google
  API-->>B: 302 to Google (state, PKCE) + state cookie
  B->>G: consent
  G-->>B: 302 /callback?code&state
  B->>API: callback
  API->>API: verify state
  API->>G: exchange code
  G-->>API: id_token (email, email_verified)
  API-->>B: Set-Cookie session (httpOnly)

name: Frontend
title: Booking Web App v1
summary: Monorepo with api/, web/, packages/shared (Zod). Next.js App Router, TanStack Query, cookie auth, proxy.ts route protection, role-based dashboards, Playwright E2E.
diagram:
flowchart LR U[User] --> N[Next.js web
RSC + client components] N -->|fetch credentials include| A[Express API] A --> P[(Postgres)] SH[packages/shared
Zod schemas] --- N SH --- A
folders:
booking/
├─ api/
├─ web/
│  ├─ app/ (/, /services, /services/[id], /book, /bookings/[id], /login, /signup, /dashboard)
│  ├─ components/ (Header, Footer, Button, ServiceCard)
│  ├─ lib/api.ts          # the only place fetch lives
│  └─ proxy.ts            # protects /dashboard
├─ packages/shared/       # Zod schemas
└─ package.json           # npm workspaces
schema: Adds booking status 'completed'. Business time zone stored (e.g. Asia/Kolkata) and all times rendered in it.
api:
PATCH /bookings/:id/status (owner only)
GET /availability?date=&serviceId=  (TanStack Query, refetched on date change)
409 → UI shows 'slot just got taken'
flow:
sequenceDiagram
  actor C as Customer
  participant W as Next.js
  participant A as API
  C->>W: choose service + date
  W->>A: GET /availability
  A-->>W: slots
  C->>W: pick slot, submit
  W->>A: POST /bookings (cookie)
  alt slot taken
    A-->>W: 409
    W-->>C: This slot was just taken, pick another
    W->>A: refetch availability
  else ok
    A-->>W: 201
    W-->>C: Confirmation
  end

name: Deployment
title: Booking App, Live
summary: Docker Compose behind Caddy on a VPS, GHCR images, migrations on deploy, Sentry, uptime alerts, nightly pg_dump to S3, RUNBOOK.md.
diagram:
flowchart LR I[Internet] -->|443| CD[Caddy
auto HTTPS] CD -->|app.domain| W[web :3000
127.0.0.1] CD -->|api.domain| A[api :4000
127.0.0.1] W -->|http://api:4000| A A --> P[(Postgres
volume)] P -->|nightly pg_dump| S3[(S3-compatible
off-server)] A -.-> SE[Sentry] UK[Uptime check] -.-> CD
folders:
deploy/
├─ docker-compose.prod.yml
├─ Caddyfile
├─ backup.sh
.github/workflows/
├─ ci.yml          # lint + tests + e2e
└─ deploy.yml      # build → GHCR → ssh deploy → migrate
RUNBOOK.md
schema: No schema change. Production DB chosen (Postgres in Docker on the VPS vs Neon/Supabase) and justified. First owner created by a one-off script, not the seed.
api: GET /health used by Docker healthcheck + uptime monitor.
flow:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Dev
  participant GH as GitHub Actions
  participant R as GHCR
  participant V as VPS
  Dev->>GH: merge PR to main
  GH->>GH: lint + tests
  GH->>R: build + push images (sha tag)
  GH->>V: ssh: docker compose pull
  V->>V: run migrations
  alt migration fails
    V-->>GH: exit 1, old containers keep running
  else ok
    V->>V: docker compose up -d
  end

name: AI Receptionist
title: AI Receptionist
summary: Chat widget + RAG over business documents (pgvector) + tool calls with pending actions confirmed by the user, evals in CI, tracing, daily token limits.
diagram:
flowchart LR U[Chat widget] --> C[/POST /ai/chat/] C --> G[Guardrails + prompt v3] G --> RT[Retriever
pgvector + keyword] RT --> L[LLM] L -->|tool_use| T[Tools → service layer] T -->|pending action id| U U -->|Confirm click| X[/POST /ai/actions/:id/confirm/] X --> SV[Booking service] C -.-> TR[(traces table)]
folders:
src/ai/
├─ prompts/receptionist.v3.md
├─ rag/ (chunk.ts, embed.ts, retrieve.ts)
├─ tools/ (check_availability.ts, create_booking.ts, cancel_booking.ts)
├─ pending-actions.ts
├─ trace.ts
└─ limits.ts
evals/
├─ cases.json   # 30 cases
└─ run.ts       # runs in CI
schema:
documents(id, name) ; chunks(id, document_id, content, embedding vector(1536), tsv)
pending_actions(id, user_id, kind, payload, status, expires_at)
ai_traces(id, user_id, conversation_id, step, input, output, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_inr)
ai_usage(user_id, day, tokens)
api:
POST /ai/summary  GET /ai/summary/stream
POST /ai/chat
POST /ai/actions/:id/confirm   ← only way a create/cancel runs
429 when the daily token limit is hit
flow:
sequenceDiagram
  actor U as User
  participant API
  participant LLM
  participant DB
  U->>API: Book me a haircut tomorrow 10am
  API->>LLM: messages + tools
  LLM-->>API: tool_use check_availability
  API->>DB: availability (as the user)
  API->>LLM: tool_result
  LLM-->>API: tool_use create_booking
  API->>DB: INSERT pending_action
  API-->>U: Confirm booking? [Confirm]
  U->>API: POST /ai/actions/:id/confirm
  API->>DB: createBooking (same auth + validation)
  API-->>U: Booked

name: Capstone
title: Client Solution v1.0
summary: A new client problem solved with the same building blocks: discovery, architecture doc, small PRs, change request handling, launch checklist, demo and handover pack.
diagram:
flowchart TB D[Discovery call] --> PS[Problem statement + success criteria] PS --> AD[Architecture doc + cost + risks] AD --> TP[Task plan, small PRs] TP --> B[Build with AI + explain-back] B --> CR{Change request?} CR -->|now| B CR -->|v2| BL[Written v2 backlog] B --> L[Launch checklist
security · evals · backups · monitoring · rollback] L --> DM[Demo + handover pack]
folders:
client-solution/
├─ README.md           # local setup vs deployment setup, AI section
├─ docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
├─ docs/API.md
├─ RUNBOOK.md
├─ docs/KNOWN-LIMITS.md
└─ docs/COST.md
schema: Depends on the client. Reuse users, roles, documents/chunks, pending_actions and traces from Weeks 2–5.
api: Depends on the client. Reuse auth, RAG and tool-calling patterns.
flow:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client (mentor)
  participant E as You
